title: Adjust feed screen opens the walk list, not the editor
detail: Bare and in the atlas phone, feed-plan.editor has no preset or steps, so it renders the plain walk. The most important feed screen cannot be reviewed.

title: End date and note screen opens the walk list
detail: No preset or steps on this screen, so it renders the unit walk. The date and note form that the notes describe is not shown.

title: Pig feed plan screen opens the walk list
detail: No preset or steps; the page that should show the Feeding block and Base curve renders the walk instead.

title: Boar and piglet rows are off-screen when opened
detail: The screen should show boars and piglets but opens at the top (C1 sow rows); the B1 and P1 pens sit far below the fold, so its point is not visible.

title: Hospital-care tag is not in view on the care-levels screen
detail: The notes point at Diarrhoea on 000801 with Move to hospital pen, but the screen opens at the top; that row is below the fold, so the four care levels are not seen together.

title: Sow 000306 reads 'Gestation · 40 days' here, '—' on the walk
detail: The record header shows 40 days, but the walk and pig-profile.empty show 'Gestation · —' (no stage start). Same pig, two stage readings.

title: Sow 000281 has different age and breed on two health screens
detail: health-record.ongoing shows 1080 days and breed '—'; health-record.many shows 1280 days and Yorkshire. Same ear tag, conflicting data.

title: Last outcome card is clipped at the sheet edge
detail: Recheck later is cut off at the bottom of the outcome list, with its border and radius cropped before the Note field.

title: Pen header counts and feed total ignore the active filter
detail: The count '3 pigs' and the kg total cover all pigs while rows show only filtered pigs. The total does not match the rows a worker sees.

title: Plural not handled: '1 days', '1 days old', '1 days ago'
detail: An ongoing condition on day 1 reads '1 days'; pig-profile Age and Last service repeat the fault. Needs a plural rule in the copy.

title: Check-in author and times are fixed text (G. Hansen, 06:40, 09:41)
detail: 'Last check-in', the walk log and the confirmation use constants, not the signed-in worker and real times. A developer cannot tell what is real.

title: An open equipment fault has no sign on the list
detail: The screen should show a pen with a note and a fault, but it renders like the walk: no fault mark exists, and the fault shows only in the pen log after it is reported.

title: Pen peek has a fault line that is never filled
detail: The preview carries a fault line in code but nothing feeds it. A pen of unknown feeding mode also reads 'Ad-lib' in the peek feed line.

title: Finding day count is stored as 1 and never advances
detail: 'Day N' is the urgency cue on rows and tags, but the prototype never increments it. Seeded findings also show 'Recorded — · —'.

title: Feed end date passes and nothing returns the pig to the curve
detail: The end date is a plain date; no rule restores the pig to the base curve when it passes, so the 'until' promise is empty.

title: Feed amounts show one decimal on rows, two in the editor
detail: A pig row reads 2.6 kg/day while the editor shows 2.64; the same number reads differently on two screens.

title: Search, review and scan show 'Gestating'; the row says 'Gestation'
detail: Find, Selected and Scan sheets use the raw stage word, the walk row uses stage and days. Same pig, two stage strings.

title: Weight, temperature and backfat accept any value above 0
detail: No upper bound or normal range; a typo of 1800 kg saves. In bulk, one invalid row blocks the whole save.

title: After a reading, the sheet drops to the walk, not the pig
detail: Reading, body condition and note forms return to the walk list; task, miscarriage and batch forms return to the record. One sheet family, two return rules.

title: Not in pig changes batch and stage with no confirmation or undo
detail: One tap among three equal choices removes the sow from her batch and sets her Off production / Open. A mis-tap cannot be recovered here.

title: Draw or delete the unit summary, sensors, batches and fault flows?
detail: 13 placeholder screens (sensors, batches, unit sheet, pen faults, report, resolve) exist only in code; no control reaches them. The Environment feature already owns sensors, maintenance and report-issue.
options: Delete all 13; Environment owns sensors and faults
Keep a one-line unit summary (pigs, pens, open faults) linking to Environment
Draw the full summary card, batch tracker and fault flow here
recommendation: Delete the sensor and fault screens (Environment covers them); keep at most a one-line unit summary with a link.

title: Is the batch tracker part of the walk?
detail: Batch tracker, batch sheet and batch filter are built but unreachable, and the filter has no field. The ROUND-3 carousel is gone. Tasks already organise work by batch.
options: Remove batch tracker and batch filter from Inspection
Place a batch row on the walk and enable the filter
Show batch only on the pig record
recommendation: Remove from Inspection; tasks and the pig record already carry batch.

title: Where does the pen head-count check live?
detail: The section text promises pen-count checks, but no Inspection screen exists. Research (pen-count.md) designs count correction as a pen-scoped event, with no screen in the atlas.
options: Add a pen count row to the pen sheet
Leave count correction to Fostering and Missing features
Drop the claim from the section text
recommendation: Add one row to the pen sheet that opens the pen count, so the text matches the product.

title: Default Care when recording a finding: No action needed or Monitor?
detail: The shortest path (choose Fever, Save) records a fever as an ongoing non-alert, so it never appears under needs attention.
options: Keep No action needed as default
Default to Monitor for all findings
Make Care a required choice with no default
recommendation: Make Care a required choice with no default, so a fever cannot silently become a non-alert.

title: Does 'Move to hospital pen' actually move the pig?
detail: Hospital pen is a care choice only: no pen change, no task, nothing. The label promises an action the app does not take.
options: Open the Move flow from the care choice
recommendation: Rename it as a flag and link to Move from the finding, so the app does not imply a move that did not happen.

title: Should 'Entered in error' need a confirmation?
detail: Save outcome closes a finding as Entered in error with no second step, and also ends a linked feed adjustment. The log keeps the record but the active one is gone.
options: Confirm line for Entered in error only
recommendation: Undo for 10 seconds; cheaper than a confirm dialog with gloves.

title: Where do medicines, brands, methods and units come from?
detail: The list is a sample ('Antibiotic A', 'Sample brand A'). Farm configuration does not exist. Prescriptions is a separate feature that may supply the medicine.
options: Farm-configured list owned by management web
Fixed global list for the pilot
Prefill from Prescriptions when a task opened the form
recommendation: Farm-configured list, prefilled from Prescriptions when a task opened the form.

title: Which feed fields show, and on which page?
detail: ASTRA-FEED-PLAN-FIELDS proposes brand, supplier, energy, protein and lysine; none is drawn, and protein and lysine units are unconfirmed. Pen page, pig page or neither?
options: Pen page only: formula, brand, nutrition
Neither; keep formula, mode and kg
recommendation: Pen page: formula and brand only; nutrition values stay in the management web.

title: Does saving a feed change drop a body-condition link silently?
detail: Save ends the link between a Thin finding and its feed adjustment; Resolve warns but the editor does not. Body condition says 'Feed stays unchanged', so the link may be dead product.
options: Keep the link and warn on the editor
Drop linking entirely (body condition records only)
Link and end the finding too
recommendation: Drop linking entirely; delete the link copy on the finding and resolve screens.

title: One way back to the curve: mode, 0% or Reset?
detail: Follow curve, percent 0 and Reset all return to the curve. Three controls for one outcome add taps and confusion.
recommendation: Keep the Follow curve mode; remove Reset and treat 0% as the same state.

title: Should 'Hold amount' show kg and an end?
detail: The tag reads 'Feed held' with kg only in a tooltip; a gloved worker cannot see how much or until when. Hold also freezes the curve until reset.
options: Keep tooltip; show on the pig page only
recommendation: Show 'Held 2.6 kg' on the tag, with no tooltip dependence.

title: Show a pen-wide feed change at the pen, not on every pig?
detail: A pen-wide +10% repeats as a tag on every row; the pen header shows only the new kg.
options: Tag once on the pen header; pig rows show only individual changes
recommendation: Tag once on the pen header; show pig tags only for individual changes.

title: Hide or disable Adjust feed on ad-lib pens?
detail: Adjust feed is offered and always answers 'unavailable': a dead end on the main bottom button.
options: Show it disabled with the reason
recommendation: Hide the button; the page already says Ad-lib.

title: What do the 'Health' and 'Feed' counts count?
detail: Health counts any condition, ongoing included; Feed mixes pigs with a change and every pig in a pen whose formula is due. A worker reads both as 'pigs to check'.
options: Health = needs attention only; Feed = pigs with an individual change
recommendation: Count needs-attention pigs only; show formula-due at the pen header, not as pigs.

title: Should check-in require anything?
detail: Check-in is allowed with nothing recorded and pens unseen. Is a unit walk a fact the farm can rely on?
recommendation: Warn with the unseen-pen count; do not block.

title: Show the care level as words on the row?
detail: Monitor, Treat in place and Move to hospital pen differ only by icon and colour; the words are in a tooltip. A gloved worker cannot tell them apart.
recommendation: Put the care word on needs-attention tags; ongoing keeps the neutral tag.

title: Edit and Close note overlap: keep one note per pen?
detail: Edit overwrites the author; Close archives to the log. Two actions on one note, and the first writer disappears from the card.
options: One note; edit keeps the original author line
recommendation: Keep one note; show 'edited by' while keeping the first author.

title: One pig note that replaces the old one, or a list?
detail: A new note overwrites the previous one and the sheet does not say so; the log keeps both.
options: Keep one note; say it replaces
recommendation: Notes only in the log; remove the overwrite.

title: What order and content for the pig record?
detail: Six blocks, with Batch, stage, Next task and Type repeated; a sow's age is in days; empty rows draw '—'. A worker at the pen needs care and next action first.
options: Attention, tasks, feeding, then a collapsed Details
Keep six blocks and hide empty rows
recommendation: Attention, tasks and feeding first; facts collapsed; hide empty rows; age in months for sows.

title: Draw lifetime figures or keep batch history only?
detail: Litters, born total, farrowing and weaning rates, interval and non-productive days are seeded but not drawn. Do supervisors need them on the phone?
options: Draw the main four on Production stats
recommendation: Leave to the management web.

title: Can ear tag or breed be corrected from Origin?
detail: The page is read-only; a wrong ear tag or breed cannot be fixed. A mistaken tag is a common farm error.
options: Edit for breed and tag with a log entry
recommendation: Read-only on the phone; corrections in the management web.

title: One door per finding: merge Edit, Resolve and Care instructions?
detail: Three bulk rows plus Edit finding and Resolve or remove change the same finding. Names clash: 'Resolve conditions' and 'Resolve or remove'.
options: One 'Update conditions' row with care and outcome together
Keep rows, rename them in line
recommendation: One row 'Update conditions' for one or many pigs, with care and outcome in one form.

title: Where do tasks live: card, Next task row, or Actions?
detail: The same task shows as a card on the record, as Next task and as a row in Actions with a cluster heading that repeats its name.
options: Cards on the record only; Actions opens the task
recommendation: Cards on the record only; remove task rows from Actions.

title: Should Move pig overwrite her stage, and say so?
detail: Moving a pig sets her stage to the new batch's stage, which the form does not state.
options: Keep, and state it on the form
recommendation: Keep the rule and state it above the Save button.

title: Miscarriage reason: free text or evidence choices?
detail: Miscarriage takes free text while 'Not in pig' offers evidence choices; two forms for a similar loss, and no check for an outcome already recorded.
recommendation: Merge into one 'Pregnancy ended' form with choices and optional text.

title: Drop the Health / General tabs in the action sheet?
detail: Two small groups sit in one scroll with footer tabs. Tabs add taps for a few rows.
recommendation: Remove the tabs.

title: Does Health own death and triage, or only conditions?
detail: Section text lists conditions, triage, deaths and treatments. Care replaced triage; deaths and prescriptions are separate features. Which belong in this section's contract?
recommendation: Findings, care and treatment only; deaths and prescriptions get their own sections.

title: Catalogue is three levels deep with no recent list
detail: Tab, door, then item before a fever is chosen. A frequent condition sits two doors deep each time.

title: Two near-identical pickers: Choose conditions and Link condition
detail: Same catalogue with another layout for treatment. Gloved workers need one picker with a recent and common list on top.

title: Four rows for one finding; Edit and Resolve both change it
detail: Edit finding, Record treatment, Resolve or remove and Review feed adjustment compete. Needs one primary action and a clear secondary.

title: Care instructions and Edit conditions are one form under two titles
detail: Same screen, different log entry ('Triage updated' vs 'Finding edited'); the second title adds no function.

title: 'Health' means three things on one screen
detail: It labels every attention row, the Health field in details and the Actions group. Duration is 'Day 2' for attention and '120 days' for ongoing.

title: Temperature 39.5 is unflagged beside a Fever finding
detail: The reading sits in General details, far from the Fever row, and nothing marks it high. No sign whether treatment was given for Fever.

title: Sideways scrolling hides the oldest ongoing conditions
detail: Lameness and Coughing are cut off in a scrolling row; the longest-running conditions are the least visible.

title: Care level differs only by icon and colour
detail: Four levels use small icons and colour; colour-blind workers and text-only readers cannot tell them apart.

title: Dose is 'per pig' in one place and 'for all' in another
detail: Dose labels differ between single and bulk; treatment from a finding and from the Health group differ only by a fixed condition.

title: Log wording differs: 'Record corrected' vs 'Finding entered in error'
detail: Bulk and single forms log the same outcome with two phrases. One wording per outcome.

title: Save reads 'Save · 0 pigs' while disabled
detail: A disabled button should say Save, not a count of zero.

title: Start date and author cannot be corrected on a finding
detail: Seeded findings show 'Recorded — · —'. The edit form changes name, care and note, never the start.

title: Two doors to a pen's feed; the note shows twice
detail: The pen header opens the editor, the Feed guidance row opens the reading page first. The note sits in a card, an Edit row and the pen log.

title: Filter state has batch, health status and manual feed, but no controls
detail: Three filters exist in state and the strip label but cannot be set. The Health lens and condition/care filters overlap.

title: Scan and Search open almost the same sheet; no ear-notch search
detail: The identity notes list ear-notch search, absent here. Camera scanning is a stub with a sample-tag button. Untagged groups cannot be found.

title: Three names for one thing: Log, Updates this walk, This walk
detail: Button, aria label and sheet title differ, and the same events repeat in each pig log and the pen log.

title: Two Back controls do the same thing
detail: The header Back and 'Back to unit' on the confirmation both return to the unit.

title: Log category is inferred from titles for old entries
detail: A renamed title silently falls into Notes. The same log and filter bar is shared with the pig log.

title: Long-press peek is hard with gloves; 'N health' misreads as pigs
detail: Hold 350 ms is hard with gloves and not discoverable. '2 health' counts ongoing conditions, not pigs needing care.

title: Selected sheet shows raw stage 'Gestating'
detail: The row repeats 'Gestating' where the list says 'Gestation · 40 days', and has no pen context for the pig.

title: Sheet header says only '2 pigs' and names nobody
detail: The worker cannot confirm who the action applies to. Body condition also sits under Measurements though it creates a health finding.

title: Row clock and record clock disagree
detail: Row: 'Gestation · 40 days' (days in stage); record: 'Last service · 40 days ago'. Two clocks that can differ; the screen duplicates the walk with one row changed.

title: Check-in sheet shows a large zero when nothing was recorded
detail: 'Recorded during this walk 0' dominates; the empty state could say so in words.

title: 'Formula due' on the walk has no explanation here
detail: Nothing tells the worker what formula change is due or when; the page shows only formula, mode and kg.

title: Editor carries mode, percent, slider, chips and a table for one decision
detail: Too much for gloved hands on one sheet; a pen-total preview exists in code and is not drawn. The scope reads '3 pigs' without naming the pen.

title: 'Feed for these pigs' sits under a tab called Pens
detail: Pens and pigs mean the same row. No row reaches equipment faults though a pen chooser exists in the code.

title: Pig feed page cannot adjust and repeats the record's block
detail: The only change path is the Actions sheet; the Feeding block is identical on the record. The curve source name is not drawn.

title: A decrease uses the same neutral tag as an increase
detail: Direction is only the sign; nothing distinguishes a drop in feed visually.

title: Four dashes in a row read as a broken page
detail: Service, farrowing, backfat and Health show '—' rows where the 'absent, not none' rule says to leave the row out.

title: Dash grid dominates; attention rows are the only content
detail: The worst case still draws Age, Breed, Weight, Temperature, Health as '—'. Hide empty rows.

title: Task type word shares names with Actions groups
detail: 'Health' and 'Production' mean task type here and action group there; tasks also appear in Actions.

title: An extra menu sits between Actions and each reading
detail: Three or four rows before the form: one more tap per reading, with body condition mixed in.

title: Body condition silently becomes a 'needs attention' Monitor finding
detail: The form does not say that the pig will show as needing attention on the walk.

title: Blocked actions sit one tap behind Actions
detail: The list usually holds one or two rows; the reason could sit on the disabled row itself.

title: Current batch shows two bare headings and little content
detail: 'Current batch' and 'This cycle' label a thin card; boars get 'Finish record' while sows get 'Finish weaning'.

title: 'Author not supplied' on seeded entries; name changes Log / Pig log
detail: The seed lacks authors, and the link and title use different names.

title: Section promises untagged groups and ear-notch search; no screen shows them
detail: Pigs says one row can mean several head and search takes an ear notch. The profile covers per-tag sows only; the Pig list entry has no source screen.

title: Walk shows no untagged groups, though the section says it does
detail: The sample unit has only tagged pigs and a single piglet (inspection.animal-types); a litter as a group is not drawn.

title: Who writes pen log entries and how long are they kept?
detail: Entries with no date stay under 'Before this walk'; custom range needs both dates. Authorship and retention are not stated.

title: What happens to a held pig as the curve grows?
detail: Hold fixes today's kg until reset; no rule says if growth or a move resets it. No expiry unless an end date is set.

title: Unticked pigs inside a ticked pen still change
detail: Opening from pens captures the pens' current pigs, unlike ticked-pig selection; the sheet only says '3 pens · 7 pigs'.

title: Adjust feed unavailable reason uses only the first pig
detail: If the first selected pig is dead and a later one is ad-lib, the reason covers one pig; no rule for mixed selections.

title: Latest treatment line shows only if it targeted this finding
detail: A treatment given for another condition is not shown here, though the pig record shows it.

title: 'Complete task / Follow up' says nothing about what was done
detail: Non-pregnancy production tasks have no outcomes; the notes do not say which tasks use this pair.

title: Pig list entry has no source screen
detail: The PRD lists the Pig list as an entry point, but that feature is a placeholder written elsewhere. How a pig is picked there is not shown.

title: Dead sow: which findings can still change?
detail: The mixed screen says conditions stay visible but cannot be changed; the notes do not say if a note or care change is allowed.

title: Placeholder screens name no owner or removal plan
detail: Thirteen placeholder screens render the plain walk, with no note saying who removes or draws them. A developer may build them from the notes.
